about_the_game:
In this demo version, you play through the first part of Henry’s childhood.

Meet Henry and experience living life as everyday objects!Demo Features:

  • THE BEGINNING OF THE GAME

    Play the beginning of Henry’s life!

  • PLAY AS 50+ DIFFERENT OBJECTS
    Unlock new rooms and objects as you solve challenges, growing a joyful playground. Explore each level to find alternative solutions, funky hats and additional story bits.

  • A WHOLESOME STORY
    Play through a wholesome story, humorously told by a narrator who will react to your mischief.

  • LOCAL CO-OP
    Experience the game with a friend in the local co-op mode. Collaboratively solve challenges or have fun inducing chaos together!


Henry Halfhead is a quirky sandbox adventure game about an odd little character with the ability to become any object within their reach. Discover every object's unique properties and abilities and cleverly combine them to take Henry through their not-so-ordinary everyday life.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04, Ubuntu 18.04, and CentOS 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 @ 3.1 GHz or AMD FX-6300 @ 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660, Radeon RX 460 or similar dedicated graphics card
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
